title: origanum vulgare var. humile
intro: Origanum vulgare var. humile, commonly known as Sweet Marjoram or Pot Marjoram, is a low-growing, perennial herb belonging to the Lamiaceae family. This plant is valued for its health benefits, which include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, helping to soothe digestive issues, reduce stress, and support immune function. The therapeutic actions of Sweet Marjoram include its sedative, anti-anxiety, and anti-spasmodic effects, making it a popular choice for aromatherapy and traditional herbal medicine. The bioactive constituents of Origanum vulgare var. humile include monoterpenes, sesquiterpenes, and phenolic compounds, such as linalool, borneol, and rosmarinic acid, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
